title: Frontend: Timeline tab — vertical timeline, event icons, type filter, pagination
description: Build the Timeline tab with a vertical timeline showing all project events, filterable by type, with load-more pagination.
acceptanceCriteria: Vertical timeline with left-side dot-and-line connector
Each event shows: icon (per type), event summary text, timestamp (relative + absolute on hover)
Type filter chips: All, Journal, Milestones, GitHub, Progress, Points
Load more button for pagination (50 events per page)

steps.details: Create src/components/project/tabs/TimelineTab.tsx. Fetch /api/projects/:id/timeline with pagination. Filter state for event type. Render TimelineEvent components.

CSS: relative container, each item has absolute left border and a dot. Use Tailwind: 'relative border-l border-muted ml-4' for container. Each event: 'relative pl-6 pb-6' with a dot: 'absolute -left-2 w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-primary'.
Horizontal scrollable row of chip buttons (shadcn/ui Badge as toggle). Selecting a type filters the API query (adds ?type= param). 'All' clears filter.
'Load more' button at bottom — fetches next page and appends to list (useInfiniteQuery).
Create journal entry, complete milestone — both appear in timeline. Filter by 'Milestones' — verify only milestone events. Verify relative timestamps show correctly.
